claims.text: Nano Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (36B/3B, mem 451M/10M) plus Flash DeepSeek-V4-Flash (288B/17B, mem 3.61B/336M); 11 memory benchmarks Flash 1st / Nano 2nd parametric (textual-memory still ahead on long-evidence retrieval); 1.86x end-to-end at 128K plus 66x persistent storage vs full KV cache.
